questions.question: M is the sister of N and O. P is the father of O. Q is the mother of M. Considering this information, which of the following statements CANNOT be verified?

options.text: Q is the mother of N
P is the father of M

questions.solution:
The family chart is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33df950b2ea2bd5c8083047b50162962b2e29f145586802f9b1cc3a4c6004dc8.png] 

Drawing the family tree as per the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b2fbafeee0f7988694188d90ea9ae0f5acc64729a6885e244c17f0776cc06e1.png] 

The gender of N is not confirmed, so N is Q's son cannot be verified.

Hence, **"N is Q's son"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: There are six persons, M, N, P, Q, R and S, in a family. S is the paternal grandmother of M. P is the sister of R. N is the father of P. M is the only son of Q and R. N does not have any married daughter. How is M related to N?
questions.solution:
Family Chart :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e70d0728e8a5dd5f196bbe20b73ec215e5eb6436edd37e5a2a585eaa6a838c1d.png] 

1) P is the sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2337dd0d8b6ce45ca87e4551f951bdfb850ea4cfd8bb2556e26f76d96151ca17.png] 

2) N is the father of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a3788fcd8b854579c8cd67e6e55d97788d1b7f2db1580fea3f5ac93aad3116c.png] 

3) N does not have any married daughter.

4) M is the only son of Q and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d01d8b774aa1ec688c3d8b48405d329daa10b8f98b7a74bff73abcb4529bdb9.png] 

5) S is the paternal grandmother of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fec66b28dbaccd63c85fa427d4d7761f0aed40ee368d3d27a28bf819a6b87186.png] 

∴ Here, M is 'grandson' of N.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Grandson".**

questions.question: Jiva is the daughter of Kamal. Kamal has two sons. Adah is the daughter of Manvita, who is the wife of Kamal’s son. Veenu is Prem’s mother. Prem is the brother of Ashok, who is the father of Adah. How is Adah related to Veenu?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/157d2ec770237097989beb9a00ef41711bba34c2aea64333d8b7821f025c749e.png] 

According to given conditions,

1) Jiva is the daughter of Kamal - Kamal is the parent of Jiva, so kamal can be either father or mother of Jiva.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ca3664ff82e66e0b6255ba90abd597b3eaf5197f95c210e8eda3afb371c3359.png] 

2) Kamal has two sons - Kamal has two sons whose names are not known yet. So Kamal has three children.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0209b60090529134ad4678bdafa78bc1d8c29aa73f633936002c3a5b54bdcf0f.png] 

3) Adah is the daughter of Manvita, who is the wife of Kamal’s son - As kamal has two sons, so Manvita is the wife of one of the son whose name is not knwon yet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf46c033f54f54213dc1fe7a1ff79b7dca0167a49697b63ac182a88ce34bbd24.png] 

4) Prem is the brother of Ashok, who is the father of Adah - As Adah is the daughter of Manvita, therefore Ashok is the husband of Manvita. So, Ashok and Prem will be the first son and second son respectivelt as Prem is the brother of Ashok.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ad1f3b83922a673e51fa60a042e5ffeb24f4839126fe5bc419fabb1330fef37.png] 

5) Veenu is Prem’s mother - As Veenu is the mother of Prem, therefore Kamal is the husband of Veenu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79caf697e9a1cf95adaff848eb631b8d56040dd1b2b75bce6661f0beb5807053.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree Veenu is the paternal grandmother of Adah, therefore Adah is the granddaughter of Veenu.

Hence, **"Granddaughter"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Jivita is the daughter of Kalyan, Kalyan has two sons. Anjali is the daughter of Manojna. Manojna is the wife of Kalyan's son. Veena is Pavan's mother. Pavan is the brother of Raju. Raju is the father of Anjali. How is Anjali related to Veena?
questions.solution:
Family Chart :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1fe9ab3dacc543807a2678698ddb41719e81d30f4eac76f273a4d30876cf59b.png] 

Family tree according to the given information :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6210e5c05d530c2929f07fbc145d84de39d88e9b0e1ce77e90e6f524fb5eab49.png] 

From family tree,

Veena is the wife of Kalyan, Kalyan is the father of Jivita, Jivita is the sister of Pavan and Raju, Raju is the husband of Manojna and Manojna is the mother of Anjali.

So, **Anjali is the granddaughter of Veena.**

Hence, **"Granddaughter" **is the correct answer.

questions.question: A and B are brothers. C is the father of D and his only daughter is married to E. F is sister of G and E is father of F. D has only one daughter. A is the son of C. C has three children. How is G related to B?
questions.solution:
Family Chart :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26bd089b50ccc65418062a914a10405a9c41cac7d59b1a2ba35d018959360e54.png] 

According to given information,

Family tree :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fe82e821d60dc82527893f16e2aa4e8725cda241f7c920a354be0a4d2a6a9db.png] 

G is the son of D.

D is the sister of B.

**So, G will be the Nephew of B.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Nephew".**

questions.question: B and D are cousin brothers. A is the father of B and the uncle of C, who is the sister of D. C’s mother is married to E, who is the brother of A. How is B related to C’s father?
questions.solution:
B and D are cousin brothers. A is the father of B and the uncle of C, who is the sister of D. C’s

mother is married to E, who is the brother of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8f4ee4534eea80969d7fb51913847c35b53b29bd5fe2bd7b9a9cbeea087636a.png] 

1) B and D are cousin brothers. 

2) A is the father of B and the uncle of **C, who **is the sister of D.

Here who is used for C not B it means A is the father of B and C is the sister of D.

3) C’s mother is married to **E, who **is the brother of A.

Here C's mother is married to E and E is the brother of A.

Family tree,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50da23121e4d98723e9e5bef4dcc7daa5f4279d3684cf545c7d6336f456b167d.png] 

B is the nephew of C’s father.

Hence, **"Nephew"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Aditi is the daughter of Sanket. Vritti is the daughter of Ankit. Kriti is the mother of Mahi. Neeta is Sanket's wife. Neeta is the mother-in-law of Vritti's mother Kriti. Which of the following statements is **NOT correct**?

options.text: Ankit is the father of Mahi.
Vritti is the sister of Mahi.
Aditi is the daughter of Neeta.
Kriti is the daughter of Sanket.

questions.solution:
The relation followed from given statements is as follows :

Family chart :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d790e27bc814701fb7e9f2b90c1bae1fe27eabb931a2ba4b5ee7a093e7bf7f6.png] 

Family diagram :

1) Aditi is the daughter of Sanket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4ab1be2582472bc5f3b91db04616ab8cb289a0739441aff0b5a171839b82967.png] 

2) Vritti is the daughter of Ankit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4356286544ce1c4386eab3dea02e1625dd516f68ab16d2eca059df7706d4ca42.png] 

3) Kriti is the mother of Mahi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/985dab517b63da28fcf0c33d7285ed37b2840bfcb463c30a81ed6cb6c8e93649.png] 

4) Neeta is Sanket's wife.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d15f623a7586d66a6c6b0f91b9a695a2c553f3eb35222a343b07797134ec8937.png] 

5) Neeta is the mother-in-law of Vritti's mother Kriti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7edd384458cc84afd9c6179a38e9d6e842f61d3e78de8c9312f1614a989505e8.png] 

By checking the given options :

1. Ankit is the father of Mahi → True (From above diagram)

2. Vritti is the sister of Mahi → True (From above diagram)

3. Aditi is the daughter of Neeta → True (From above diagram)

4. Kriti is the daughter of Sanket → False (Here Kriti is Daughter-in-law of Sanket from above diagram hence, False)

∴ Here, 'Kriti is daughter of Sanket' is not correct from given statements.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Kriti is the daughter of Sanket".**

questions.question: Vishal is the husband of Narmada. Pratik is the brother of Gaurvi. Kartik is the son of Prathmesh, who is the husband of Arti. Arti's son is married to Narmada. Gaurvi is the daughter of Vishal. How is Prathmesh related to Gaurvi?
questions.solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cdd0b30cffaf954e65ff899730e11e9e4ceb2b8a3106f0f1cf7dc6cc2718c84.png] 

Given:

1) Kartik is the son of __**Prathmesh, who**__ is the husband of Arti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aa47f90883272f94eee76ffbeb5461fed596d1cd189ba6f63e3b600a1916628.png] 

2) Arti's son is married to Narmada.

3) Vishal is the husband of Narmada.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c6cace7964b9b98cdbf84fa1a1d93748f279aaa4bd1ce60b8276c237618034f.png] 

4) Gaurvi is the daughter of Vishal.

5) Pratik is the brother of Gaurvi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/201df536a4c27e709dfa64350a645b36b689e97258d4bd3886417d29cec96fe8.png] 

Clearly, Prathmesh is the "Paternal grandfather" of Gaurvi.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Paternal Grandfather".**
